sign_in.brand.tagline: Every page read. Every fact traced.
sign_in.brand.point_pages: Sorted and numbered. Nothing thrown away.

sign_in.password.title: Welcome back
sign_in.password.intro: Sign in to carry on where you left off.
sign_in.error.credentials: That email and password don't match. Please try again.
sign_in.error.invalid: Please check the email address and password.
sign_in.code.title: Enter your code
sign_in.code.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and type the 6-digit code it shows.
sign_in.enrol.title: Set up the code on your phone
sign_in.enrol.intro: Each time you sign in, we'll ask for a 6-digit code from your phone. It keeps the records safe.
sign_in.enrol.step_app: Open an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
sign_in.enrol.step_scan: Scan this picture with the app.
sign_in.enrol.step_code: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
sign_in.enrol.qr_alt: Picture to scan with your authenticator app
sign_in.enrol.key: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
sign_in.codes.title: Your backup codes
sign_in.codes.intro: If you lose your phone, you can sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Write them down or print them, and keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
sign_in.recover.title: Use a backup code
sign_in.recover.intro: Lost your phone? Sign in with one of your backup codes, then set up the code on your new phone.
sign_in.forgot_form.title: Reset your password
sign_in.forgot_form.intro: Type your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
sign_in.forgot_form.sent: If that address has an Avodeck account, we've sent a link to it. The link works for one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: Use at least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. For your safety, we've signed you out everywhere.
reset.no_token: This link is not complete. Please open it again from the email.
email_confirm.title: Your email address
email_confirm.waiting: Thank you. Now open the link we sent to your other address.
email_confirm.changed: Your email address has been changed.

account.email.label: Email
account.orgs.title: Your organisations

account.password.label: Password

account.code.always_on: Always on. It keeps the records safe.

setup.stale: Someone changed this while you were working. Please reload the page to see the latest version.
setup.profile.title: Your expert profile
setup.profile.intro: You fill this in once. We use it for every case.
setup.profile.goes_with_you_text: Your profile belongs to you, not to your practice or a team. If you move on, it stays with you.
setup.about.title: About you
setup.roles.title: Where you've practised
setup.roles.intro: Add each role with its dates. We check them against the time each case is about.
setup.roles.to_hint: Leave this empty if you still work in this role.
setup.roles.stale: This role was changed somewhere else. Reload the page to see the latest.
setup.roles.invalid: Please check the dates. The end date must come after the start date.
setup.training.title: Expert training
setup.template.title: Your report template
setup.template.intro: Upload your Word template. Then tell us which part of the report goes under each heading.
setup.template.kept: Your template is kept with your profile.
setup.template.not_word: This file isn't a Word document we can use. Please choose a .docx file.
setup.template.suggested_note: These are suggestions only. Nothing is saved until you save the headings.
setup.template.suggest_paused: Suggestions aren't available just now. You can choose the sections yourself.
setup.declaration.title: Declaration and signature
setup.declaration.fixed: This wording is set by the court rules and can't be changed.
setup.declaration.addition_hint: This goes after the set wording in every report.
setup.declaration.tile_fixed: The standard wording. It's added to every report exactly as the rules set it out, so it can't be edited here.
setup.declaration.tile_points_one: {{count}}-point declaration, ready to use. You can add to it once and it will be used for every case.
setup.declaration.tile_points_other: {{count}}-point declaration, ready to use. You can add to it once and it will be used for every case.
setup.declaration.tile_plain: Your declaration is ready to use. You can add to it once and it will be used for every case.
setup.declaration.locked: Your declaration is in a report you've sent, so it can't be changed now.
setup.signature.title: Your signature
setup.signature.intro: Draw your signature in the box, or upload a photo of it.
setup.signature.pad: Box to draw your signature in
setup.signature.photo: Upload a photo of your signature
setup.signature.not_picture: We couldn't use this picture. Please try a PNG or JPEG photo.
setup.balance.title: Your balance over the last {{months}} months
setup.balance.intro: How many cases you've taken for each side. Courts look for experts who work for both sides.
setup.new_case.title: Start a new case
setup.new_case.intro: Drop in what the {{sender}} sent you. Your files are kept exactly as they arrived.
setup.new_case.records_hint: Everything that was sent, in any order.
setup.new_case.other_hint: Statements, chronologies and letters from the other side. Drag files here or choose files.
setup.new_case.who_for_hint: It decides who invoices, which template is used and who else can help. You're the expert either way, and only you sign.
setup.new_case.kind: What kind of case is this?
setup.new_case.invalid: Please check the details and try again.
setup.new_case.forbidden: You can't start a case for this practice or team.
setup.case.label: A short name for the case
setup.case.label_hint: Only you and your team see this. For example, initials.
setup.case.side: Which side are you instructed by?
setup.case.invalid: Please check the case details and try again.
setup.details.title: Set up the case
setup.details.intro: Add the letter of instruction and check the case details.
setup.letter.title: Letter of instruction
setup.letter.intro: We read the letter to find the questions you've been asked and some case details.
setup.letter.reading: We're reading the letter. This takes a minute or two.
setup.letter.invalid: We couldn't use this file. Please try a PDF or Word document.
setup.prefill.title: Found in the letter
setup.prefill.intro: Check each one. Nothing changes until you choose "Use this" and save.
setup.instructed.title: Who instructed you?
setup.instructed.name: Their name
setup.instructed.joint: You're instructed jointly. Notes go to everyone who instructed you.
setup.instructed.invalid: Please add their name and firm.
setup.same_person.title: Have you had a case about this person before?
setup.same_person.intro: We keep only a scrambled form of the number, to warn you about a case you may already have.
setup.same_person.found: You may already have a case about this person: {{label}}.
setup.same_person.none: We didn't find another case about this person.
setup.same_person.invalid: This number doesn't look right. Please check it.
setup.oral.title: Were you told anything by phone that isn't in the letter?
setup.oral.intro: Type or dictate what you were told. It goes into your report's instructions.
setup.oral.invalid: Please add what you were told and the date.
setup.conflicts.title: A quick check before you start
setup.conflicts.intro: Courts need to know you're independent. Please answer each question.
setup.conflicts.detail_needed: Please say a few words about this.
setup.conflicts.invalid: Please check your answers and try again.
setup.conflicts.paragraph: What we'll add to your report
setup.conflicts.preparing_one: Your bundle is still being prepared: about {{count}} minute left
setup.conflicts.preparing_other: Your bundle is still being prepared: about {{count}} minutes left
setup.conflicts.preparing_unknown: Your bundle is still being prepared
setup.conflicts.warning.declare_again: You've changed an answer since you confirmed them. Please confirm your answers again.

setup.conflicts.warning.coverage_none: The roles in your profile don't cover the time this case is about. Please check you worked in this kind of setting then.
setup.withdraw.intro: You'll stop working on this case. We'll draft a note for whoever instructed you.
setup.withdraw.done: You've stepped back from this case.
setup.questions.title: What you've been asked
setup.questions.intro: These are the letter's own words. Please check each one.
setup.questions.assumptions: What you've been asked to assume
setup.questions.kind: What kind of question is this?

setup.questions.assumption_label: Assumption you've been asked to make
setup.questions.expertise_pack: This may be outside your expertise.
setup.questions.expertise_expert: You marked this question as outside your expertise.
setup.questions.expertise_parts: You can answer the {{parts}} part and leave the rest.
setup.questions.last_one: Confirm the last one to continue
setup.questions.further: Got a further letter or phone call? Add it
setup.questions.locked: You've confirmed what you've been asked.
setup.questions.reading: We're still reading the letter. This page will update by itself.
setup.questions.warning.read_failed: We couldn't read the letter. Please try again.
setup.questions.warning.letter_without_f: A further letter was added without its file. Please add the letter so we can find what you've been asked.

setup.questions.warning.reopened: A further letter has changed what you've been asked. Please check the questions again.

setup.questions.warning.outside_expertis: You've marked a question as maybe outside your expertise. Please let whoever instructed you know.

setup.notes.joint: You're instructed jointly, so this note goes to everyone who instructed you.

setup.notes.questions_reopened.body: Your further letter changes what I've been asked. I've checked the questions again.
